g.text: AUTOSAR HLD Intelligence & Traceability Assistant — End-to-End RAG Architecture
Production Workflow: Multi-Version Ingestion, Hybrid Retrieval Fusion, Structured LLM Generation, Deterministic Grounding & Architecture Validation
STAGE 1: DOCUMENT INGESTION, STRUCTURAL CHUNKING & EMBEDDING GENERATION
Parses AUTOSAR High-Level Design PDFs (v1.0 & v2.0), applies table extraction with OCR fallback, classifies architectural semantic blocks, and stores dense embeddings.
Graceful fallback if OCR binaries missing on host
Batch Size: 32 chunks per forward pass
STAGE 2: QUERY HANDLING, INTENT ROUTING & ARCHITECTURE-AWARE HYBRID RETRIEVAL
Accepts user architectural queries, validates inputs via FastAPI, routes architectural intent, and computes composite multi-signal ranking with version balancing.
8. RETRIEVAL ENGINE: BASELINE VS ARCHITECTURE-AWARE HYBRID
Encodes query with BGE-small embedding model → FAISS L2/Cosine search
Pool size: search_k = min(N, max(top_k * 5, 25)) with version/project filter
Composite Score = ( 0.50 × Semantic + 0.30 × Entity + 0.20 × Section ) × GovMultiplier
Entity: SWC, Port, Signal, Interface match | Section: §6 (Ports), §5 (Signals), §7 (Deps), §4 (Interfaces)
For revision queries across versions, enforces balanced top-k representation for both v1.0 and v2.0
[Conditional] If evidence for either version is missing → Abstains rather than hallucinating comparison
+40.1% Hit Rate Improvement across Architectural Benchmarks
STAGE 3: CONTEXT ASSEMBLY & RIGID PROMPT CONSTRUCTION
• Deduplicates chunks and formats standard evidence headers:
--- CHUNK: {chunk_id} | DOC: {doc} | VER: {ver} | PAGE: {p} | SEC: {sec} | TYPE: {type} ---
Strictly isolates version 1.0 chunks from version 2.0 chunks in context string
1. Grounded Answers Only | 2. No Fabrications | 3. No Extrapolations
4. Insufficient Evidence Abstention | 5. Exact Chunk ID Citations
6. True/False Architecture Distinction | 7. Multi-Version Separate Claims
8. Table Attribute Binding | 9. Architectural Integrity | 10. Prompt Injection Guard
11. Rigid Structured JSON Schema Output Only
Injects User Question, Evidence Context & Cross-Version Comparison Directives
CLOUD: Google Gemini Free-Tier (Official google-genai SDK)
Safe fallback prevents raw syntax leak
rag/grounding_checker.py (No Extra LLM Call - 100% Deterministic Python)
Filters English & reporting stopwords; requires >= 60% content word support in cited chunk
Prevents claims stating version 2.0 properties from citing version 1.0 chunks
check_claim_contradictions: Validates signal datatypes (e.g. VehicleSpeed float32 vs float64)
HIGH (Score>=0.85 & Sim>=0.60) | MEDIUM | LOW (Grounding<0.60 or Citation Invalid)
Triggered via GET /architecture/validate or UI Explorer tab. (NOT triggered per standard Q&A query!)
• Gating flag: review_required = true on low confidence,

svg.text: PHASE 4: RESPONSE SYNTHESIS, TRACEABILITY CITATIONS & GOVERNANCE GATING
Final RAGResponse Schema, Streamlit UI Rendering, and Capstone Safety Boundaries

g.text: "answer": "The VehicleSpeed signal is routed via CanIf to Com... [C1][C2]",
"review_required": false, // Set to true if confidence < 0.60 or ungrounded
Rich Markdown rendered answers with [C1] tags
Retrieval Mode switcher: Hybrid vs Baseline
Collapsible expanders for each cited chunk
Shows exact Doc, Page, Section, and Cosine Score
Highlighting of matched entities and signals
Displays SWC topology and orphaned components
Records approval / correction to SQLite DB
This system is an engineering research and traceability assistant; it is NOT certified under ISO 26262 ASIL A-D.
It does not constitute a qualified tool under ISO 26262-8:2018 Clause 11 (Tool Confidence Level TCL1-3).
All generated traceability matrices and architecture assessments require human sign-off before production use.
191+ Unit, Integration, Security, and Governance Tests Executed and Passing
Covering: Chunker (14 tests) | Security Injection & Path Traversal (11 tests) | FAISS Search & Index (13 tests)
Cross-Version Balanced Retrieval (8 tests) | Phase 8 Governance & Reports (11 tests) | Phase 2b-4 Integration (95 tests)
Deterministic grounding verification guarantees zero ungrounded responses without review_required=true flag.
